Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.
At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing…
“I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

translations.web: Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines.
translations.bsb: One day Samson went down to Timnah, where he saw a young Philistine woman.
